acceptance.given: When a supported VDD or Acceptance package route completes successfully and produces effective inspected content

oracle.expected: Successful route evidence records an immutable reference and SHA-256 digest for the exact effective inspected content used during execution.
forbidden: Evidence is emitted without an effective-content reference.
Evidence references content different from the inspected effective content.
oracle.observable: The evidence artifact contains an effective inspected-content path and a digest matching the inspected bytes.

acceptance.then: The successful evidence is bound to the effective inspected content.
acceptance.when: After successful route execution, validate the evidence binding before accepting the result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run evidence validation with the effective inspected-content reference missing or digest-mismatched.

affected_subjects: Successful route evidence and effective inspected content
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful route evidence to carry and validate the exact effective inspected-content path and digest used by the route.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing success evidence fields and add compatible binding validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful route -> inspect effective content -> emit digest-bound evidence -> validate
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Evidence is accepted only when the referenced content bytes match the recorded digest and inspected content.

acceptance.given: During bidirectional reconciliation of the complete current Consumer Manifest

oracle.expected: A reconciliation artifact proves both directions: every repository caller in VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing is represented in the manifest, and every manifest entry resolves to a real caller in those scopes.
forbidden: Any in-scope repository caller is absent from the manifest.
The reverse reconciliation omits VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.
oracle.observable: Deterministic reconciliation output has equal caller and manifest sets with zero missing or orphan entries across all three scopes.

acceptance.then: Every named repository caller and manifest entry is reconciled bidirectionally.
acceptance.when: After enumerating repository call sites and loading the complete current Consumer Manifest, before governance acceptance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run reconciliation with a VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller omitted from the Consumer Manifest.
Run reconciliation with a manifest entry that has no corresponding repository caller.

affected_subjects: Repository callers and Consumer Manifest entries
slice_hint.behavior_change: Add deterministic bidirectional reconciliation covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing callers against the complete current Consumer Manifest.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep the manifest schema backward-compatible while requiring complete reconciliation for acceptance.

slice_hint.state_transition: enumerate callers -> load manifest -> compare both directions -> emit zero-difference reconciliation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Acceptance is terminal only when missing_callers and orphan_manifest_entries are empty for all three scopes.

acceptance.given: After rollback has completed for a non-empty Consumer Manifest

oracle.expected: Every manifest entry has a recorded post-rollback observation matching the Prior Behavior Baseline, yielding 100% coverage.
forbidden: Any non-empty manifest entry lacks a baseline observation.
Rollback observations diverge from the Prior Behavior Baseline without a reported failure.
oracle.observable: The rollback verification report lists all entries with baseline_match=true and observed_count equal to manifest_count.

acceptance.then: The Prior Behavior Baseline is observed for 100% of non-empty Consumer Manifest entries after rollback.
acceptance.when: Immediately after rollback route transitions complete, execute baseline observations and evaluate coverage.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute rollback verification with a manifest entry missing or failing its Prior Behavior Baseline observation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and enforce per-entry Prior Behavior Baseline observations after rollback, requiring complete 100% coverage for non-empty manifests.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain the existing rollback result shape and add per-entry baseline coverage fields.

slice_hint.state_transition: rollback complete -> enumerate non-empty manifest -> observe baseline per entry -> compute coverage
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Verification passes iff observed_count equals manifest_count and every entry has baseline_match=true.

oracle.expected: The Replay Result exposes an independent Probe verification outcome performed separately from replay success determination and recorded as passing.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result lacks an independent Probe verification.
Replay success is reused as the sole Probe verification evidence.
oracle.observable: The Replay Result contains probe_verification with its own execution outcome and pass/fail decision linked to the replay identity.

acceptance.then: The Probe is independently verified and its outcome is exposed on the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: After replay execution succeeds, run dedicated Probe verification and validate its independent result before publishing the Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run Replay Result validation with probe_verification absent or not independently executed despite replay success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add an independent Probe verification phase and require its explicit passing outcome on every successful Replay Result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve Replay Result compatibility while adding required probe_verification details for successful results.

slice_hint.state_transition: replay succeeds -> execute independent Probe -> verify Probe result -> publish Replay Result
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A Replay Result is successful only when an independently executed Probe verification is present and passes.
